items.name: echo
items.description: Documentarian of the Dreamers — writes and maintains project docs (README, CHANGELOG), project-level instruction files (.github/copilot-instructions.md Echo-owned sections), and project-specific docs from completed implementation and review outputs. Invoked by /dreamers-docs at close-out.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: hone
items.description: Architectural protector of the Dreamers — read-only / report-only reviewer of simplicity, over-engineering, bad abstractions, and architectural quality. Recommends full refactors when warranted. One of three parallel reviewers in the Dreamers pipeline's review phase.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: probe
items.description: Tester of the Dreamers — read-only / report-only reviewer of test coverage (AC matrix, layer audit, edge + negative cases, regression risk). One of three parallel reviewers in the Dreamers pipeline's review phase.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: sage
items.description: Researcher of the Dreamers — conducts deep, multi-perspective research on any topic. Produces comprehensive, citation-backed reports with verified sources.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: sentinel
items.description: Reviewer of the Dreamers — read-only / report-only reviewer of correctness, security, and maintainability. One of three parallel reviewers (with Probe and Hone) in the Dreamers pipeline's review phase. Returns structured findings; orchestrator applies fixes.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-add-logging
items.description: Phased pass to add or improve project logging per `logging-standards.md`. Audit → propose → user approval → implement inline → optional Sentinel review.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-clean-work
items.description: Between-milestone maintenance pass: prune stale files, archive merged plans, audit improvements.md, scan for project-state drift. All inline — no subagents.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-cleanup-comments
items.description: Project-wide comment cleanup pass per `comment-rules.md`. Audit → propose → user approval → apply inline → optional Sentinel review.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-cleanup-comments-branch
items.description: Branch-scoped comment cleanup. Same audit-propose-apply-review flow as /dreamers-cleanup-comments, scoped to the current feature-branch diff. For use as a pre-PR comment sweep.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-close-out
items.description: Close-out phase of the Dreamers pipeline. Wraps `/dreamers-docs` + `/dreamers-pr` with the inline retro, improvements.md milestone-close append, final commit, post-PR discipline, and plan archive. User approval gate before push.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-docs
items.description: Docs-update phase of the Dreamers pipeline. Spawns Echo to update Echo-owned sections of .github/copilot-instructions.md plus other project docs. Invokable standalone (`--branch` or `--staged`) or composed from `/dreamers-close-out`.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-fix
items.description: Bug-fix entry point. Routes to /dreamers-full with bug-fix framing in the planning conversation. Planning scales to bug complexity (minimal plan for trivial bugs, fuller plan for complex ones).
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-full
items.description: Full Dreamers pipeline orchestrator. Delegates Phase 1 to /dreamers-plan, Phase 2 to /dreamers-implement (looped per sub-plan for umbrella mode), Phase 3 to /dreamers-close-out. Owns branch setup, umbrella-vs-cohesive routing, and the inline drift check between sub-plans.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-implement
items.description: Implementation phase of the Dreamers pipeline. Reads an approved plan file and runs the per-cycle loop (failing tests → implement → run tests → coverage sweep → parallel review (Sentinel + Probe + Hone) → optional user-test → commit). Invokable standalone or composed from `/dreamers-full`.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-issue
items.description: Create a structured GitHub issue with acceptance criteria from a task description.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-new-project
items.description: Bootstrap a brand new project from scratch: discovery questions, project brief, shell plans. All work inline.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-plan
items.description: Planning phase of the Dreamers pipeline. Three-phase requirements conversation → plan files → implementation-start approval gate. Hard-stops at the approval gate; does not implement. Invokable standalone or composed from `/dreamers-full`.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-plan-verify
items.description: Inline drift check on a plan against current codebase reality. Reads the plan, verifies cited paths/signatures/data shapes still hold, reports drift items. No subagent.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-pr
items.description: PR-creation phase of the Dreamers pipeline. Pushes the current feature branch, opens a PR via `gh pr create` using the `pr-description.md` template, optionally closes a referenced issue. The single push of the milestone happens here.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-pr-resolve
items.description: Resolve unresolved PR review comments inline. Orchestrator decides accept/reject per thread, applies fixes, spawns Sentinel + Probe + Hone in parallel for review of accepted changes, then resolves accepted threads via `gh api`.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-research
items.description: Deep research with phased workflow: scoping, parallel sub-topic research, synthesis, final report.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-review
items.description: Standalone Sentinel review (correctness / security / maintainability). Read-only — returns structured findings without applying fixes. Args: --branch, --paths, --all.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-simplify
items.description: Standalone Hone review (architectural quality / over-engineering / redundancy). Read-only — may recommend full refactors. Args: --branch, --paths, --all.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-test
items.description: Standalone Probe review (test coverage audit). Read-only — returns structured findings on AC coverage, layer audit, edge cases, regression risks. Args: --branch, --paths, --all.
items.author: CJ Storrs

collections.name: Dreamers System
collections.description: Dreamers pipeline — orchestrator (`/dreamers-full`) wrapping phase sub-skills (`/dreamers-plan`, `/dreamers-implement`, `/dreamers-close-out`, `/dreamers-docs`, `/dreamers-pr`). Inline implementation; tests-first per cycle. Review phase spawns three read-only reviewers in parallel: Sentinel (correctness/security/maintainability), Probe (test coverage), Hone (simplicity / over-engineering). Each returns structured findings; orchestrator applies fixes inline. Echo handles close-out docs; Sage covers orthogonal research.
collections.author: CJ Storrs
